run_singlepoint_calculations: run singlepoint energy and force calculations on a batch of atomic structures using an ASE calculator
calculate_chunked_structures: calculate properties on a chunked subset of structures for parallel array job execution
write_results_to_json: write singlepoint calculation results to a compressed JSON file in the results directory
normalize_properties_by_natoms: normalize calculated properties by number of atoms or a custom key from atoms.info
save_target_properties: extract and save target properties from atoms alongside calculated results in the output
